cohort: 197 pregnant women presenting with decreased fetal movements in the third trimester to the labor room of Govt. Medical College, Kottayam, India between February 2021 and October 2021.
finding: Women presenting with decreased fetal movement are associated with poor perinatal outcomes including preterm birth, low APGAR score, perinatal asphyxia, respiratory distress, meconium aspiration syndrome, NICU admission, perinatal mortality, and increased rate of cesarean section.
